description_expanded:
This beautiful new South Side home is a wonderful addition to the Alys Beach Rental Program. This vacation rental home features 4 bedrooms, all with private baths as well as additional sleeping areas and is a short walk to the Gulf and the emerging Town Center. The first floor features a guest bedroom with one queen-sized bed as well as an expansive kitchen with large center island, dining area, and spacious family room overlooking a private courtyard with a pool and covered seating area. Guests will also find the laundry room and a half-bath on this level. As you wind your way up an elegant staircase to the second floor, you will find the primary suite with one king-sized bed, gas fireplace, and private balcony overlooking the South Sea Garden pedestrian path. Continuing down the hallway is a full bath and large alcove with two twin beds as well as the third bedroom with one king-sized bed. The fourth bedroom is quite unique to Alys Beach with a large in-law suite with two bunk beds, a kitchen with a sitting area and one king-sized bed. This suite is accessible from the home or by an outside stairway for additional privacy. Finally, rising to the third level, guests will discover a large outdoor terrace with an outdoor gas fireplace and wonderful views of Alys Beach. There is even a slight view of the Gulf from the east side of the terrace. Parking for this home is in a two-car garage. Guests staying in Alys Beach vacation rental properties enjoy personalized concierge services, exclusive access to the Caliza Pool and Restaurant, ZUMA Wellness Center and Café, advance access to purchase tickets to many of our signature events, a stunning new racquet sports venue, and private beach access. Each property includes Wifi, cable TV, YOLO coffee, kitchen supplies and 24-hour security included with the Resort Fee. An interactive vacation rental guest portal will be available to you and your guests to further help you plan your best vacation experience at Alys Beach. Beach chair set ups, beach food and beverage delivery, bicycle rentals, water sports equipment, private signature experiences and family portrait photography sessions (through our Preferred Photographer program) are also available at additional costs – our concierge will be happy to make recommendations. Please note: Due to special medical constraints, service animals are not permitted in this home.

Alys Beach is expanding its development surrounding 15 Fairwind Lane. The photography above may not reflect the current views as impacted by construction. For a construction map, please click the link below.
